    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    Represents a bishop chess piece and calculates its possible diagonal moves.
    Board
    Represents a chessboard and manages its pieces, moves, captures, and board state.
    BoardPrinter
    Prints the chessboard and the history of moves and captures.
    CheckValidator
    Validates check conditions and determines whether moves leave a king safe.
    King
    Represents a king chess piece and calculates its possible moves.
    Knight
    Represents a knight chess piece and calculates its possible moves.
    Main
    Runs the chess game and manages player turns, move input, check detection, and checkmate detection.
    MoveHandler
    Handles chess moves by validating input, checking piece movement rules, recording captures and moves, and ensuring the king remains safe.
    Pawn
    Represents a pawn chess piece and calculates its possible moves.
    Piece
    Represents an abstract chess piece with a position and color.
    PieceColor
    Represents the two possible colors of a chess piece.
    Position
    Represents a position on a chessboard using row and column coordinates.
    Queen
    Represents a queen chess piece and calculates its possible moves.
    Rook
    Represents a rook chess piece and calculates its possible moves.
